name: probe: longest frozen interval in the splash attract loop (measures dead air from the play/defense input gates)
description: The feed tile visibly froze on possession changes. Cause was the human-input gates: the play picker parks the possession, and the defense picker sets gamePausedRef with an 8250ms (DEFENSE_PICK_MS) self-dismiss - with no overlay drawn that reads as the court simply stopping. SplashCourt now answers both at GATE_MS=0. This samples player positions every 100ms for 30s and reports the longest run of consecutive samples in which NOTHING moved, which is exactly the dead air a scroller would see. Diagnostic plus one assertion: no freeze longer than 2s.

steps.expression: (() => { window.__s = { prev: '', run: 0, max: 0, samples: 0, frozen: 0 }; window.__t0 = Date.now(); return 'reset'; })()

steps.until: (() => { const s = window.__s; const sig = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="splash-player-"]')].map(n => { const g = n.querySelector('g,image,rect'); return n.getAttribute('data-anim') + (n.parentNode.textContent||''); }).join('|') + [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="splash-player-"] text')].map(t=>t.getAttribute('x')+','+t.getAttribute('y')).join(';'); s.samples++; if (sig === s.prev) { s.run++; if (s.run > s.max) s.max = s.run; s.frozen++; } else { s.run = 0; } s.prev = sig; return Date.now() - window.__t0 > 30000; })()

steps.expression: (() => { const s = window.__s; return 'samples=' + s.samples + ' frozenSamples=' + s.frozen + ' longestFreezeMs=' + (s.max * 100); })()

steps.message: longest frozen interval should be under 2000ms once the input gates are auto-answered
